disqualifier.note: Independent path-delta axes: JSDoc says a move that also renames queues both. Two separate ifs enqueue moveItem vs renameItem; neither/parent-only/name-only/both are all legal.

Independent filesystem existence of sources.jsonl vs the text directory; both must be true to emit a spec, but missing-sources-only, missing-text-only, and both-missing are legal and just drop that root.

evidence.note: saveBusy is input.saving; saveDisabled is !sessionOpen || saving, so saveBusy => saveDisabled. previewBusy/previewDisabled (line 74-76) are the same implication.
openBusy and openDisabled are both assigned input.opening; openBusy && !openDisabled is never constructed.
Each button binds aria-busy to *Busy and disabled to *Disabled; no arm handles busy-without-disabled.

notes: Three independent action phases (open 2, save 3, preview 3) flattened into busy/disabled bits. Input ToolbarState already triaged as D1; this projection introduces the implications.
